context: Two friends gossip about their dads at the cafe
purpose: Teach: カラオケ/シャワー/親父/外出/ねこ/飲ま/眠っ/つまらない

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえメイ、うちの親父また昨日カラオケで朝まで歌ってたの。
lines.en: Hey Mei, my dad was at karaoke singing till morning again yesterday.
lines.style: Casual gossipy tone, slightly exasperated friend venting at length

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えー、すごい元気だね。うちの父はもうつまらない人で、休日も外出しないんだよ。
lines.en: Wow, so energetic. My dad is such a boring person, he doesn't even go out on holidays.
lines.style: Warm gentle delivery with a soft sigh of resignation

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それはそれで楽だよ。うちのはお酒も毎晩飲まされてる感じで、もう心配。
lines.en: That sounds easier honestly. Mine drinks every single night, I'm getting worried.
lines.style: Concerned best-friend tone, lowered voice almost whispering

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: でも家に帰ってシャワーも浴びずにそのまま眠っちゃうとか、ない?
lines.en: But doesn't he just collapse and fall asleep without even taking a shower?
lines.style: Curious teasing lilt with a leaning-in close posture

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あるある!ソファでぐっすり眠ってて、うちのねこと一緒にいびきかいてる。
lines.en: All the time! Snoring away on the couch right next to our cat.
lines.style: Laughing animated delivery with expressive hands gesturing around

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: かわいいじゃん。うちの親父はねこにも興味なくて、本当に無趣味なの。
lines.en: That's adorable actually. My dad doesn't even care about cats, he has zero hobbies.
lines.style: Affectionate chuckle that softens into a wistful tone

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: じゃあ今度二人の親父さん連れて、家族でカラオケ行こうよ。
lines.en: Then let's take both our dads to karaoke together as a family outing sometime.
lines.style: Bright cheerful proposal with eyes lighting up brightly

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいね、お酒は飲ませないでね。私のお父さん、すぐ酔っちゃうから。
lines.en: Sounds great, but don't let them drink please, my dad gets drunk so fast.
lines.style: Soft laughing warning paired with a fond eye-roll
